claims: Syracuse was the No. 9 seed in the 2026 Women's NCAA Tournament.
Iowa State was the No. 8 seed in the 2026 Women's NCAA Tournament.
The game was the first round of the 2026 Women's NCAA Tournament.
The game was at Gampel Pavilion.
Uche Izoje led Syracuse with 23 points and 7 rebounds.
Laila Phelia scored 18 points for Syracuse.
Syracuse secured a second-round matchup against UConn.
Audi Crooks scored 37 points to lead Iowa State.
Syracuse held off a late Iowa State rally.
Syracuse advanced to the second round of the 2026 NCAA Tournament
